MIAMI
NOW UNITED SERVES 117 CITIES COAST TO COAST AND TO HAWAII
TO BETTER SERVE YOU...
A QUICK, CONVENIENT SOURCE OF FLIGHT INFORMATION
Our new quick-reference timetable lists the most frequent
United flights to and from a given area. A similar city version
appears in many originating and connecting cities across
United's system. For a complete listing of all United flights,
contact the nearest United Air Lines office.
Finding the exact flight you wish to take is a quick, simple
step with this handy guide. Instead of searching through
many pages, you'll find all the information you need listed in
The left page lists destination cities in alphabetical order.
The right page lists cities of origin-also in ABC order. After
each city listing, the "Leave" and "Arrive" times appear in
chronological order. The flight number follows.
Please note also, we list additional information that can prove
helpful in selecting your flight...
• days of week flight is in operation
• number of stops en route
• type of aircraft
• type of meal service
• service (First Class, etc.) and fares
• limousine fare from city to airport
• mileage and direction from city to terminal
Pertinent information regarding each flight is fully covered and
we hope you'll find this new timetable greatly simplified and
easier to read.
This easy-reference timetable is another example of United
Air Lines Extra Care in every detail of your flight.
